nom: MEDIHEAL Vita Collagen Eye Ampoule Patch

avis.texte: I've really enjoyed these patches. I have used them most mornings and enjoyed having them in my routine. they stay on my face pretty well, sometimes a few adjustments are needed. I like that there are a lot in the container, instead of individually packaged eye masks. these have become a part of my everyday routine and will continue to use them.

After you take the patches off and rub in the extra serum it leaves a strange layer on your skin that sort of peels or needs to be rubbed off. Im not sure if maybe my skin just doesnt absorb something in them but ive never had this happen with eye patches.

I've used these for a few weeks now, the formula does pill if there is too much product on the patch. I love the cooling effect and I do find it does somewhat brighten under the eye. Easy to use and no reaction and I have sensitive skin. Overall does what it says and I have seen a slight improvement.
I do not find many products that actually help my dark under eyes. But these did! Cons is that they pill and they have so much product the slip right off your face at first!

avis.titre: Softens wrinkles on my 38 yo face
avis.texte: I LOVE these things! They're a nice, large size so I can position them to cover both my undereye and my crows' feet. I choose to wear them overnight and when I wake up I don't have creases and wrinkles from side sleeping. I've noticed a reduction in the fine lines under my eyes. In regards to the reviewed who mentioned pilling, I personally haven't found a collagen product that doesn't do that (including famous brands) I would suggest using them at night and not before makeup. I hope that helps!
i do notice the difference, my under eyes have been less dull.

The serum is best overnight to fully absorb, otherwise it pills so much!! Looks like Vaseline balling up and off of my face throughout the day. The formula just needs a bit more work, I wanted to love it, but can't even return since I tossed the package :(
These eye patches are amazing! they brighten my under eyes so much!!
i love this product!! after i used it my eyes felt so smooth :blush:
